title: VSCode Terminal Breaks When Using Compact Command
body:
**Bug Description**
Using compact from within a vscode console window on a macbook pro (latest model), causes the claude code input/output to break (it just says "Bash" but doesn't show the command or the output.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: vscode
- Version: 0.2.32
- Feedback ID: 97a99c03-4383-449b-a04d-64ef03068f44
author: paulbettner
